questions.prompt: Which Chinese emperor is linked to the Terracotta Army?
questions.fact: The army was found in 1974 by farmers digging a well, and no two of the roughly 8,000 soldiers share the same face.

questions.prompt: What is the term for the tiny blood vessels connecting arteries and veins?
questions.fact: They are about one red blood cell wide, so cells pass through in single file to exchange oxygen.

questions.prompt: Which sport uses a stick with a netted pocket to throw and catch a ball?
questions.fact: Lacrosse was played by Indigenous nations across North America long before Europeans arrived, sometimes with hundreds of players and games lasting days.

questions.prompt: In Doctor Who, what is the blue time machine called?
questions.fact: TARDIS stands for Time And Relative Dimension In Space. It is stuck as a police box because the disguise circuit broke in 1963 and was never repaired.

questions.prompt: Which country is home to the city of Jaipur?
questions.fact: Jaipur was painted pink to welcome a royal visit in 1876, and buildings in the old city are still required by law to stay that colour.

questions.prompt: Who narrates much of 'The Book Thief'?
questions.fact: Death narrates, and admits early on to being haunted by humans rather than the other way round.

questions.prompt: What is a firewall designed to help control?
questions.fact: A firewall decides which traffic may pass. The name comes from the solid walls built into buildings to stop fire spreading between sections.
